entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Use MSBuild's command-line parser instead of hand-maintained switch allowlists #56123
  • Add an agent workflow to identify potentially stale `[Ignore]` attributes #56121
  • Single-file publish to a UNC share is ~10x slower on SDK 10 than on SDK 9 #56117
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] Failed to install NET11 RC2 SDK in a custom location. #56112
  • [aw] Issue Monster Assigner produced no safe outputs #56110

Closed

  • [aw] Detection Runs #55753
  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet-watch RenameSourceFile hangs in Windows Helix test work item #55980
  • Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.IntegrationTests RegistryTests.CanReadManifestFromRegistry: flaky failure - CONTAINER1014 Manifest pull failed (external registry BadRequest) #55495
  • [file-based apps] dotnet restore fails when -consoleLoggerParameters is passed #53695
  • [[NETSDKE2E]][openSUSE]With .NET 10.0.401, running dnx returns /usr/bin/dnx: line 1: ../share/dotnet/dnx: No such file or directory on openSUSE #55935
  • Flaky: rzc generate exited with code 1 #54894
